## What this site is

IPTV For Firestick USA is a US-facing setup desk for Amazon Firestick. The preferred player is 7 MOTION. A private 24-hour trial starts on WhatsApp +44 7307 410512. Access stays in the chat. Login details stay on that thread.

## Who it is for

People in the United States who already have a Firestick (home living room or travel). Typical note: city + device. New York, Dallas, Los Angeles, Miami, and other US cities are fine.

## 7 MOTION path (about 5–10 minutes)

1. Message WhatsApp. One note is enough: Firestick IPTV USA + trial, plus your US city and that you have a Firestick. The prefill is ready — no email form.
2. Start the 24-hour trial. You get a private 24-hour trial, no card. Check it on your own TV. Access stays in the chat — we do not publish a public playlist on this site.
3. Prep the Firestick. Put the Firestick on 5 GHz Wi-Fi, or a short Ethernet adapter if you have one. Lite is fine at 1080p; 4K Max is calmer for sport.
4. Install 7 MOTION. On Firestick we prefer 7 MOTION — faster start, less sideload from a forum. The player and steps arrive on the same WhatsApp thread.
5. Enter the chat details. Start data stays on WhatsApp. Do not hunt a public playlist file on the open web.
6. Check a night at home. A game or a show on your own screen. If it holds, then you pick a duration — not before.
7. Choose a duration if it holds. If the night at home holds, pick a duration on the same WhatsApp thread. Login details stay in that chat.

## Answer-first FAQ

Q: How do I get IPTV on Firestick in the USA?
A: Message WhatsApp with your US city and that you have a Firestick. The walkthrough follows the 7 MOTION path in about 5 to 10 minutes and starts a private 24 hour trial. Access stays in the chat. Login details stay on that thread. This site does not post a playlist file to download.

Q: What is the 7 MOTION path?
A: The path is seven short steps: message WhatsApp, start the 24 hour trial, prep the Firestick, install 7 MOTION, enter the chat details, watch a night at home, then pick a duration only if it holds. Login details stay in that chat. There is no playlist file to download on this site.

Q: Where do the login details come from?
A: They stay in WhatsApp. After you message with your city and device, the trial details arrive in that same chat. This site does not post a playlist file for you to download, and it does not ask you to hunt one on the open web. Use the thread you already opened.

Q: How do I start the 24-hour Firestick trial?
A: WhatsApp is enough: send your city and your device. The 24 hour trial needs no card and no email form. You pay only if a duration fits after a night on your own TV. The home page lists 1 month for $12, 3 months for $25, 6 months for $30, and 1 year for $55, each paid once.

Q: Why 7 MOTION instead of a forum player?
A: 7 MOTION stays simple on Firestick. The player and start data stay on the same WhatsApp thread, so you are not sideloading a random file from a forum.

Q: Where do I see pricing and how do I contact you?
